title: Calendar
intro: Business calendars: time zone, workweek and holidays. Working-day due dates skip weekends and holidays.
readOnly: Only a technical administrator can change calendars. You can view them.
none: No business calendar is configured. Working-day due dates are Unknown until one is.

create.title: Add a calendar
create.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, hyphen or underscore.

edit.title: Edit the calendar
edit.description: Changes apply to due dates computed from now on; dates already computed keep their calendar version.
edit.timezoneHint: An IANA time zone, for example Asia/Riyadh.

holiday.title: Holidays
holiday.intro: Holidays are skipped like weekends when working days are counted.
holiday.name: Holiday
holiday.rule: A holiday ends on or after its start date and spans at most 31 days.

calc.title: Working-day calculator
calc.intro: Adds working days to a date with this calendar, as the server computes approval and task due dates.
calc.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 250.
calc.enter: Enter a start date to compute the due date.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intro: Background jobs of the platform and their schedules. A job never decides a business approval; it can only remind and escalate.
jobs.readOnly: Only a technical administrator can change job schedules.
jobs.editDescription: The worker picks up the new schedule without a restart.
jobs.cronHint: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example 0 6 * * 0.
